president.quote: Our main goal is to always seek client satisfaction by fulfilling our promises through excellence in our work with on-time delivery.
president.body1: At Wjeen International Company Ltd, we are deeply committed to fulfilling our clients' diverse requirements across general construction, renovation, maintenance, and all facets of civil work. Our continuous efforts to help and assist our clients in offering top-notch projects, services and systems have been crowned through the co-founder experiences.
president.body2: Our structuring is precisely built to cope with diversified projects supported by our specialized and experienced manpower who were selected adequately to ensure quality and meet the contingency plans. Our systems are woven to our size and aspirations to ensure effectivity in our team work with an upper hand in planning and controlling.
president.name: Eng. Ismail ibn Abd Allah Al Sayed

story.title: Founded in 2008, Building Across the Kingdom
story.body1: Wjeen International Company Ltd was founded in the year of 2008. The headquarter of the company is located in Jeddah city, in the western region of Saudi Arabia, with branch offices in Dammam and Jubail city in the eastern region.
story.body2: Wjeen IC always targets the superior level of services and higher level of finished product for its clients. By having that, Wjeen IC is always ready — in the present and future — to apply the overall construction knowledge to provide services primarily in industrial and infrastructure projects, principally in Saudi Arabia and Gulf countries.
story.body3: Wjeen IC not only provides general construction services, renovation and maintenance but, more importantly, it builds a solid relationship with its reputed clients as a financially stable company. The relationship is built on trust, integrity and the knowledge to manage and execute projects in an unequalled way in the industry — and the ISO certificates are maintained and updated with high intention.
